ideas.title: The Impact of the Child Care Funding Freeze on Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the effects of the $10 billion child care funding freeze on Minnesota's child care centers.
questions: What were the immediate effects on child care centers?
How did the freeze affect low-income families?
ideas.insight: This story could highlight the importance of stable funding for child care centers and the impact of politically motivated funding decisions.

ideas.title: FBI Wiretap on State Sen. Louise Lucas
ideas.description: Investigate the circumstances surrounding the FBI wiretap on State Sen. Louise Lucas.
questions: What were the reasons for the wiretap?
What were the results of the investigation?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on the FBI's investigative practices and the potential for political bias.
